name: Find raw settings command usage vs SDK typed settings client

text:
In this Flutter monorepo (smart glasses/watch/earphone platform), I need details to plan migrating a Feature from sending raw BLE protocol frames (via `GlassesOrder`/`GlassesCommandSender` in `packages/common/common_ble_protocol`) for a device-settings-related instruction, over to calling the existing SDK typed settings client in `packages/core/core_device_native_runtime` instead.

Please investigate and report with concrete file paths, line ranges, and code snippets:

1. Read `specs/capabilities/device_settings.md` in full — report the capability contract: consumers, scope, public Dart inputs/outputs, Result<T> errors, supported settings (e.g. volume, brightness, etc.), platform/device support matrix, and any stated migration/ownership notes.

2. Read `packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/lib/src/settings/service/device_settings_client.dart` (and any other files in that `settings/` directory, e.g. models, provider, native adapter) — report the full public API surface (methods, DTOs, streams) of the typed settings client, and how it's currently instantiated/exposed (e.g. via `DeviceNativeRuntime.settingsClient`, any Riverpod provider).

3. Search `packages/common/common_ble_protocol/lib/src/protocol/glasses_order.dart` for any settings-related raw command builders (volume, brightness, screen brightness, mic, speaker, do-not-disturb, etc. — anything settings-like under domain 0x34 or elsewhere). Report the exact static methods/constants with their byte layout comments.

4. Search `packages/common/common_ble_protocol/lib/src/service/glasses_command_sender.dart` for any settings-related convenience methods (e.g. setVolume, setBrightness) built on top of those raw builders.

5. Search the whole repo (especially `packages/feature/`) for actual call sites that invoke these raw settings commands — i.e. grep for the specific method names found in steps 3-4, and any Feature-layer usage of `glassesCommandSenderProvider` for settings purposes. Report the Feature package name(s), file paths, and surrounding code (e.g. a settings screen/controller) that call these raw commands currently.

6. Check if any Feature already calls the SDK typed settings client (`DeviceSettingsClient` or its provider) — report which ones, if any.

7. Check `docs/plans/0035-native-device-capability-migration.md` for any specific guidance, status, or precedent about migrating settings-related raw commands to the SDK typed client — report relevant excerpts including any explicit list of pending/completed migration items for settings.

8. Report how `DeviceNativeRuntime.settingsClient` (or equivalent) is wired up/injected at the App level (e.g. in `apps/*/lib` or a provider setup file), so the plan can reference the correct provider name Features should use.

Report back organized by these 8 points with exact file paths and line ranges.
I'll investigate the capability spec, typed settings client, raw BLE command paths, and existing call sites across the monorepo.
